items.title: Welcome to Roaring Readers
items.content:
Roaring Readers Book Club

Where every page turns into a conversation

Join a community of readers exploring new worlds, one chapter at a time.

Our Mission

To foster a diverse and inclusive community of lifelong learners who find joy in the written word. We believe that sharing stories builds empathy, sparks curiosity, and connects us across different walks of life.

items.title: About the Club
items.content:
About Roaring Readers

Founded in 2005, Roaring Readers began as a small gathering of friends in a local coffee shop. Today, we are a thriving digital and physical hub for book lovers. We don’t just read books; we dissect themes, challenge perspectives, and celebrate the impact of literature on our daily lives.

Whether you read one book a year or one a week, there is a seat at our table for you.

items.title: Events & Meetings
items.content:
Monthly Meetup

  • Where: Paterno Library and Zoom
  • When: Every third Thursday at 7:00 PM

Special Events

  • Guest Author Q&A: A live session with featured authors
  • Annual Book Swap: A summer picnic exchange
  • Literary Trivia Night: A team-based competition

New members are welcome at any meetup. You don’t need to have finished the book.

items.title: Blog
items.content:
The Bookworm’s Ledger

Our member-written blog. Here is what we post about:

  • DNF Corner: Honest reviews of books we didn’t finish
  • Member Spotlight: Monthly interviews
  • Local Bookstore Tours: Hidden gems in the city
  • Top 5 Lists: Curated reading lists
A book you didn’t finish can still start a great conversation.

items.title: Join & Contact
items.content:
Have a book recommendation or a question? We’d love to hear from you.

  • Location: HUB-Robeson Center, Suite 204
  • Phone: (814) 555-2732
  • Email: hello@example.com
  • Office Hours: Tuesday and Thursday, 2 to 4 PM

Ready to start your next chapter? Come to any monthly meetup and say hello.
